styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny stool, roughly 14x12 px, in yellow with a blue basin. The dark edge pixels are tinted, not neutral (0% near-neutral), so the outline is not a pure black sticker line, but it is thin and the same dark tone is used everywhere around the shapes. A careful artist would see this as thinner and flatter than the reference, so it fails.
